text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important use is text understanding, which allows machines to read and find meaning in what people write. NLP also powers translation tools, so you can quickly turn a sentence from English into another language. Another common example is sentiment analysis, where computers study reviews or messages to decide if people feel happy, angry, or neutral. Finally, chatbots use NLP to talk with users and answer questions in a helpful way. Thanks to NLP, our daily technology is becoming smarter and easier to use.
